action-audit.limitation: Finite smooth local jets; no on-shell solution, spatial grid, long-time conservation test or nonlinear gravity constraint solution.
action-audit.question: Do action derivatives agree with the written equations on nonzero jets?
action-audit.reading: Maximum Hessian residual 7.43e-16; equation residual 4.88e-16; operator metric residual 8.88e-16 against 1e-10.
action-audit.significance: Independent action polarization and complex-step force distinguish the written equations from a copied principal matrix.

characteristic-surfaces.limitation: Only four coframes and two of six fields are displayed; all saved sectors enter the check. Local frozen coefficients do not establish a metric derived from microscopic reception.
characteristic-surfaces.question: Do all six matter sectors share one coframe null cone in shifted coordinates?
characteristic-surfaces.reading: The six saved roots coincide across 20 directions on 200 coframes; maximum null-polynomial/root residual 1.77e-15. Coordinate drift differs across coframes.
characteristic-surfaces.significance: The action implementation retains the selected common matter principal cone even in shifted coordinate frames.

failure-controls.limitation: The quartic term is excluded from SS OCF 1 and tested on one flat static gradient. It neither proves topology protection nor exhausts all constitutive alternatives.
failure-controls.question: Do unhealthy Z and quartic orientation change distinct accepted properties?
failure-controls.reading: Negative Z=-0.5 fails kinetic positivity; separately versioned quartic orientation action gives speed 0.934947 versus metric speed 1.
failure-controls.significance: The audit can detect both a bad kinetic sign and an extra material characteristic that a common coordinate shift cannot remove.
